    Ray categories without long morphisms #

    If composites of two irreducible morphisms vanish (no long morphism; the algebra has zero relations of length two), two paths with the same nonzero value are equal, so the homotopy relation is trivial and the fundamental group is the vertex group of the free groupoid on the quiver, a free group when the quiver is connected (RayCat.isFreeGroup_pi1_of_radSq). This is the first case of the proof of Theorem 2 of Bongartz, Indecomposables live in all smaller lengths.
